items.title: First concrete poured for Bailong 2 nuclear power unit
items.summary: First concrete was poured for the nuclear island of Bailong Nuclear Power Plant's unit 2 at 18:27 on Sunday 27 September.

items.title: Q&A: Zeno Power CEO on the demand for space nuclear power
Italy's Senate approves a return to nuclear power
items.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's bill paving the way for a return to nuclear power in Italy after four decades was passed in the Senate by 81 votes to 51, with seven abstentions.
